chatgpt_box.titel: AI runs through your ChatGPT subscription
chatgpt_box.text: The app's runs go through your ChatGPT subscription. ChatGPT does not report costs in USD, so the “AI (agent runs)” row only shows amounts from earlier runs under Claude. There is no budget limit per run: the time limit per run, the limits of your subscription and the limit on runs per day apply. The Task Centre shows usage in tokens.

steuerung.modus_hinweis: hard = calls are blocked · soft = warning only
steuerung.ohne_usd: ChatGPT has no costs in USD and no budget limit per run. The time limit per run and the limits of your ChatGPT subscription apply; the limit on runs per day still applies.

fussnote: Usage: Apify via API sync; subscriptions from config/budgets.yaml. Limits take effect immediately on all paid calls made by this app (hard = blocked). Spending outside the app (Apify console, interactive {{name}} sessions) only shows up after the next sync and cannot be prevented. USD→EUR rate: {{kurs}}.
